draft_diagnostics.scope: Binary single-layer topology diagnostics; no manufacturing certificate.

metadata.periodicity_scope: Draft and unperturbed/wavy yarn centerlines repeat; nested twist/migration phases are not forced to close.
metadata.clearance_scope: Reference-section bounds only; run actual polyline capsule audit for global separation.
metadata.flyaway_scope: Optional C2 outward loop excursion of an existing fiber; no duplicated fiber objects, but length/volume can change. No mass conservation or fitted staple statistics.

normal.meaning: outward geometric triangle normal at ray hit
normal.gamma_or_light_transport: none; numeric map values are not physical display radiance

orientation.meaning: centerline tangent of the represented ply or fiber
orientation.sign_invariance: t and -t describe the same line and share color
orientation.glyphs: unoriented line segments from valid pixel-center tangents

material.palette_rule: nonnegative integer index modulo palette length
material.meaning: synthetic source assignments, not material inference or dye colors

antialias.order: map each sample to RGB, average premultiplied RGB and hit alpha, then unpremultiply
antialias.storage: straight RGBA float32; alpha=coverage; RGB=0 where alpha=0
antialias.reproducible_sources: display_sources.npz preserves hit mask, normal, tangent and height supersamples

camera.all_lengths: mm; scale bars explicitly labelled um

camera.backend_origin_rule: float64 pixel formula cast to float32 before ray query
camera.world_height_definition: z coordinate of nearest actual triangle hit; not ray distance

scope: A separate compact demonstration input, not a revised optical experiment or fitted specimen.
Ply envelopes and explicit fibers are distinct geometric representations.
The draft is a 2-by-2 basket; 3-ply denotes the number of plies per yarn.
No radiance, material identification, measured color or FabricGen numerical replication is implied.
